title: Teacher Policy Entry
description: Mapping from task shape to recommended models per role: teacher (gold labels, hard reasoning, judge), bulk_labeler (cheap volume), comparator (open-weight reproducibility row), inspector (logit/hidden-state research). Decisions: slm-learning-197 (Opus is THE teacher; open Qwen is comparator/labeler/inspector, not teacher rival), slm-learning-204 (teacher rows require provenance/cost/acceptance/license metadata).

task_shape.description: Short label that maps to delta_packet.task_shape or eval task category

primary_teacher.description: Model registry id for the gold-label teacher

fallback_teacher.description: Use when primary is rate-limited / over budget

bulk_labeler.description: Cheap-per-row labeler when scale matters more than peak quality

comparator.description: Open-weight comparator for paper-row reproducibility (Charter Row 8)

inspector.description: Open-weight model for logit/hidden-state research probes

verifier.description: Test runner / executor / contract checker that produces objective truth
